framework_name: SafetyVision AI Enterprise Risk Assessment Matrix

Working at Heights.description: Scaffolding, roofing, elevated platforms, ladders, and unprotected leading edges (>1.8m).

Hot Work & Welding.description: Welding, torch cutting, brazing, grinding, and open flame thermal operations.

Electrical Safety.description: Live conductors, high voltage distribution, switchgear, panel maintenance, and lock-out/tag-out.

Heavy Machinery & Struck-By.description: Cranes, forklifts, excavators, suspended loads, moving mobile plant, and vehicular traffic.

Chemical & Hazardous Materials.description: Toxic substances, acid/alkali handling, fumes, dust, confined space atmosphere, solvent vapors.

General Construction & PPE.description: Standard active construction, civil works, warehouse maintenance, and physical handling.

1.label: Minor
1.description: Superficial injuries, first-aid case, no lost work days.

2.label: Moderate
2.description: Medical treatment required, short-term lost work days (<3 days).

3.label: Serious
3.description: Severe injury, fractures, burns, prolonged lost work time.

4.label: Severe
4.description: Irreversible harm, amputation, life-threatening critical trauma.

1.label: Rare
1.description: Practically impossible or occurs once every 10+ years.

2.label: Unlikely
2.description: Could occur under rare combined failure conditions.

3.label: Possible
3.description: Has occurred occasionally across industry or site history.

4.label: Likely
4.description: High probability of occurrence during routine shifts.

5.label: Almost Certain
5.description: Continuous unsafe condition; incident imminent without intervention.

Low.action: Routine control monitoring and standard toolbox briefing.

Medium.action: Supervisory review, corrective action within 24 hours, mandatory PPE audit.

High.action: Immediate job pause or halt until control measures, permit re-check, and PPE compliance are verified.

Critical.action: IMMEDIATE STOP WORK ORDER. Evacuate zone, notify EHS Director, lock out hazards, full formal inquiry.

rules: If visual evidence is missing or marked unavailable, flag visual uncertainty and base findings strictly on verbal narrative and indexed policies.
If detected bounding box confidence is between 0.35 and 0.50, flag detection ambiguity and recommend on-site manual supervisor validation.
If policy similarity score is below 0.20, explicitly document a policy retrieval gap rather than fabricating compliance clauses.
If incident narrative lacks specific location or machinery details, annotate environmental uncertainty in the report.
